study.question: Does adding the committed g2 diversity-factorized feedback residual to the committed g0 pair-joint model exceed both frozen source bests (especially macro AUC0.8314095190610717), and does diversity support contribute beyond a same-capacity exposure residual under the pair representation?
study.hypothesis: Observed: g0 macro AUC0.8314095190610717 / macro Logloss0.054588730712398906 exceeds g2 0.8281021879164492 /0.05480275974062607 and DIN0.8099233880793816 /0.05662295138414975. g0 is better on every task and every supplied history-length aggregate, so these records do not demonstrate a g2 winning slice or a representation defect. Implementation inspection finds a consequential untested distinction: g0 has target relation/pair sums and collapsed feedback memory but lacks the g2 user-centered, unweighted local-rate residual with advertisement-concentration support. Hypothesis: that residual exposes useful deviations from the visible-user feedback background that remain useful after pair-joint modeling; diversity shrinks repeated-ad slots more strongly than exposure support. Redundancy or interference is plausible. The compact source records alone do not establish that diversity caused g2 performance.

study.proposed_difference: Compose rather than ensemble: append g2 residual modules after every g0 initialization, inside torch.random.fork_rng(devices=[]), then add their four logits to g0 tower logits. No additional embeddings, events, labels, attention keys or tokens. Every cell uses g2 feedback_moment_mode=factorized and centering_mode=user. Factor A: existing g0 pair_content_source and pair_count_source both joint versus both factorized. Factor B: g2 support_mode diversity versus exposure. The exposure cell retains the full active feedback residual, raw fractions/counts, centering, dimensions, histogram computation and parameter count. This is a same-capacity test of diversity, not a test that all added residual capacity is irrelevant. All four source files differ only in CONFIG. This first-stage factorial is not a full older-backbone x residual-presence factorial.
predictions: Primary prospective prediction: joint_diversity exceeds both committed source macro AUCs under full frozen validation; all four task AUC/Logloss deltas versus DIN, g0 and g2 are reported, with no undeclared per-task veto.

Diversity-specific prediction: AUC(joint_diversity)-AUC(joint_exposure)>0 with identical active parameter dimensions. A gain only over g0 is composition evidence, not evidence that diversity is necessary.

Pair interaction estimate: [AUC(joint_diversity)-AUC(joint_exposure)]-[AUC(marginal_diversity)-AUC(marginal_exposure)]. No sign is required by the utility hypothesis; positive suggests synergy, negative attenuation, and near-zero approximate additivity. Nonzero interaction alone does not establish the reliability explanation.

Algebraic prediction: empty slots support0, unique positive IDs support=n, one repeated known advertisement support1, and missing/padding IDs count as singleton groups. Diversity weight d/(d+4)<=n/(n+4), affecting only interpolation reliability, not event weights or raw counts. It estimates concentration, not independent sample size.

Zero-start candidate outputs should equal g0 at initialization when common parameters and inputs match. Frozen pair sources also start equal because pair_bank is zero. Added empty-history logits must stay0 in train/eval; post-training backbone updates can still change empty-history predictions.

Report supplied length bins empty/1-16/17-64/>64 as predeclared descriptive slices with samples and task positives/negatives; tiny empty-history auxiliary counts cannot support reliable mechanism claims. Identity-concentration slices require an authorized host diagnostic; absent that interface do not invent them. Repeat supported gains on paired seeds if resources permit.
falsifiers: Joint_diversity failing to exceed g0 macro AUC0.8314095190610717 rejects this implementation as an improved selection under the fixed recipe, without refuting every possible composition.
Joint_exposure matching or beating joint_diversity opposes a diversity-specific explanation even if both improve on g0; then generic residual information/capacity or optimization remains plausible.

Marginal pair replacement matching/beating the joint pair version opposes a claim that simultaneous pair evidence is necessary for the residual gain. No pair-content-versus-count attribution is possible because those switches move together.

Disappearance or reversal on paired repetition, compute disadvantage without a quality gain, or task trade-offs outweighing the declared macro improvement weakens practical support. No single-seed significance claim.

Failed initialization equivalence, padding/target-action invariance, finite BF16 forward/backward or full-split identity checks invalidates the run until corrected. Preserve the failed attempt and charged cost rather than using its score.
alternative_explanations: Extra residual parameters or an additional route to historical feedback could explain a combined-versus-g0 gain; the exposure residual controls nominal capacity while retaining feedback information, but a full residual-presence factorial and active alternative readout may still be needed.
G0 memory/pair paths may already encode the useful g2 signals; changes can be redundant or cause optimizer interference under a single pass.
Diversity is a heuristic for repeated encoded advertisement IDs. It may alter regularization scale without representing uncertainty, and encoded collisions/missingness may create apparent effects.

Slot user-background includes the slot itself; shrinkage is not an independent Bayesian prior. Historical masks can overlap, recent means prefix position rather than elapsed time, and auxiliary labels are category/brand based24h events rather than ad-attributed conversions.

Only three imported successful records are authorized here. Searches for agent diversity/factorized memory returned no matches; failed and abandoned source trajectories are unavailable. Do not turn that absence into an all-positive campaign narrative or import unscoped results.
Validation reuse, seed noise, user correlation and rare auxiliary positives can produce small apparent gains. No held-out assessment is available in this operational phase.
